temporary_native_adapter.light_status: Temporary native adapter: source custom C++ intensity units/defaults are unconfirmed. Serialized nonzero intensity uses x10 candela; unspecified active lights use 30 cd and native white. Chosen by render review after the earlier x750 adapter saturated the arena; x1 was too dim to read the hall. Serialized zero-intensity placeholders remain off.
temporary_native_adapter.fire_status: Niagara sprite sizes and Atlas-A hardcoded grid are unconfirmed; size/grid are temporary display settings. Use original actor scale, exact texture, source FM_FireSubUV_A Speed=35, and source B_01 SubUVTexRC=(8,4), Speed=30. Cascade fire uses its serialized core StartSize and Fire_core_size.
temporary_native_adapter.flag_status: Small native cloth wave, temporary. Source FlagWave_Big records Height_Light=60 and Speed_Light=.25 but source shader units/formula are not reconstructed. Native 9 cm avoids large reference-pose deformation; no Chaos/PhysX cloth port.
temporary_native_adapter.light_radius_shadow_boundary: Unknown native radius uses temporary 1000 cm. Added fill lights do not cast shadows to avoid redundant local shadow atlases; this is a native presentation choice, not a verified source shadow setting.
temporary_native_adapter.cascade_animation_boundary: Native continuous flipbook uses temporary 30 frames/s; source looping_speed is not proven to be frames/s. Source core material atlas grids, separate emissive/opacity textures and serialized StartSize are preserved. Source emitter spawn/lifetime/distortion are not ported.
temporary_native_adapter.billboard_scale_boundary: UE 5.8 MaterialBillboardComponent.cpp builds camera-facing world-size vertices with transform scale cancelled by ViewToLocal. Bake source scale into element size: FireWall width uses authored local Y (length), height Z; ordinary fire uses X/Z. This axis mapping is a native approximation of the source emitter, not recovered Niagara code.
temporary_native_adapter.niagara_atlas_speed_boundary: Native atlas graph interprets source FM_FireSubUV_A Speed=35 and FMI_FireSubUV_B_01 Speed=30 as frames/s; the proprietary source shader speed unit/formula is unverified. These are source values used through a native timing approximation.

boundary: No gameplay phase logic, damage, blocking, camera attachment or Character edits. Fire proxies have no collision. Water spline Niagara interfaces are recorded separately; existing native water surfaces are retained.
